def.en: A fixed idea that everyone in a group is the same, such as 'all boys are rough' or 'all girls are shy'.
def.hg: Ek fixed soch ki kisi group ka har insaan same hota hai, jaise 'saare ladke rough hote hain' ya 'saari ladkiyan shy hoti hain'.

def.en: People of every gender getting the same respect, rights, opportunities and responsibilities at home, in school and at work.
def.hg: Har gender ke logon ko ghar, school aur work pe barabar respect, rights, opportunities aur responsibilities milna.

def.en: Treating a person unfairly or worse than others because of who they are, for example their gender, caste, religion or disability.
def.hg: Kisi insaan ke saath is wajah se unfair ya doosron se bura behave karna ki woh kaun hai, jaise uska gender, caste, religion ya disability.

def.en: Making sure everyone can take part and feels welcome, by removing whatever keeps a person out.
def.hg: Yeh pakka karna ki har koi part le sake aur use welcome feel ho, aur iske liye har woh rukawat hatana jo kisi ko bahar rakhti hai.

def.en: Someone who stands up for a person or group facing unfair treatment, even though they are not part of that group.
def.hg: Woh insaan jo unfair treatment jhel rahe kisi person ya group ke liye khada hota hai, bhale hi woh khud us group ka hissa na ho.

def.en: Having a brain that learns, senses or communicates differently from most people, as in autism, ADHD or dyslexia. It is a difference, not a defect.
def.hg: Aisa brain hona jo zyadatar logon se alag tareeke se seekhta, sense karta ya communicate karta hai, jaise autism, ADHD ya dyslexia mein. Yeh difference hai, defect nahi.

def.en: A person's own inner sense of being a woman, a man, both, neither or something else. Only the person can tell you what it is.
def.hg: Insaan ka apne andar ka ehsaas ki woh woman hai, man hai, dono hai, koi nahi hai ya kuch aur hai. Yeh sirf wahi insaan bata sakta hai.

def.en: Describes a person whose gender identity is different from the sex recorded at birth. It is an adjective: 'a transgender woman', not 'a transgender'.
def.hg: Aise insaan ke liye word jiski gender identity birth pe likhe gaye sex se alag hai. Yeh adjective hai: 'ek transgender woman' bolte hain, 'ek transgender' nahi.

def.en: Describes a person whose gender identity is not only 'man' or only 'woman'. Some non-binary people use 'they' as their pronoun in English.
def.hg: Aise insaan ke liye word jiski gender identity sirf 'man' ya sirf 'woman' nahi hai. Kuch non-binary log English mein apne liye 'they' pronoun use karte hain.

def.en: The pattern of who a person feels romantic or sexual attraction to, for example heterosexual, gay, lesbian or bisexual. It is not a choice.
def.hg: Insaan ko romantic ya sexual attraction kiski taraf hota hai, iska pattern, jaise heterosexual, gay, lesbian ya bisexual. Yeh choice nahi hai.

def.en: Describes a person who feels little or no sexual attraction to anyone. Asexual people can still want close friendships and loving relationships.
def.hg: Aise insaan ke liye word jise kisi ki taraf sexual attraction bahut kam ya bilkul feel nahi hota. Asexual log phir bhi close dosti aur loving relationships chaah sakte hain.

def.en: Describes people born with chromosomes, hormones or anatomy that do not fit typical definitions of male or female. It is a natural variation of the body.
def.hg: Un logon ke liye word jo aise chromosomes, hormones ya anatomy ke saath paida hote hain jo male ya female ki typical definition mein fit nahi hoti. Yeh body ki natural variation hai.
